constraints.explanation: the deepest joint, the paint and all the relief fit inside the height range
a joint is no wider than its board

controls.explanation: The top coat.
controls.label: Paint colour

controls.explanation: The coat under the paint, where the paint has chipped.
controls.label: Primer colour

controls.explanation: Bare timber, where a chip goes through the primer.
controls.label: Wood colour

controls.explanation: The dirt that gathers in joints and on the face.
controls.label: Grime colour

controls.explanation: Plain timber, or boards side by side with a V-groove between each two.
controls.label: Boards

controls.explanation: How many boards fit across one tile, when the timber is boarded.
controls.label: Boards across

controls.explanation: How wide the V-groove between two boards is.
controls.label: Joint width

controls.explanation: How deep the V-groove between two boards is.
controls.label: Joint depth

controls.explanation: How many grain lines fit across one tile.
controls.label: Grain fineness

controls.explanation: How many grain streak lengths fit down one tile; fewer means longer streaks.
controls.label: Grain length

controls.explanation: How far the grain shows through the paint as relief.
controls.label: Grain relief

controls.explanation: How much the grain under the paint shows as a change of tone.
controls.label: Grain tone

controls.explanation: How many brush marks fit across one tile.
controls.label: Brush mark fineness

controls.explanation: How many brush mark lengths fit down one tile.
controls.label: Brush mark length

controls.explanation: How deep the brush marks in the paint are.
controls.label: Brush marks

controls.explanation: How much a brush mark shows as a change of tone.
controls.label: Brush tone

controls.explanation: How thick the paint and primer are together, which is how deep a chip is.
controls.label: Paint thickness

controls.explanation: Higher means fewer chips in the paint.
controls.label: Chip rarity

controls.explanation: How many chip-sized cells fit across one tile; more means smaller chips.
controls.label: Chip size

controls.explanation: How many patches of chipped paint fit across one tile; more means smaller patches.
controls.label: Chip patches

controls.explanation: Higher means fewer chips go through the primer to the wood.
controls.label: Bare wood rarity

controls.explanation: The most grime darkens the timber, in percent.
controls.label: Grime

controls.explanation: How many patches of grime fit across one tile; more means smaller patches.
controls.label: Grime patches

controls.explanation: How much the paint on one board differs in brightness from the next.
controls.label: Board variation

controls.explanation: How matte the paint is, in thousandths; gloss paint is low.
controls.label: Paint roughness

controls.explanation: How matte primer and bare wood are, in thousandths.
controls.label: Chip roughness

controls.explanation: Millimetres between the lowest and highest point the height map can hold.
controls.label: Height range

controls.explanation: How far around each point the surface is compared to find crevices.
controls.label: Occlusion radius

controls.explanation: How far below its surroundings a point must sit to be fully shadowed.
controls.label: Occlusion depth

controls.explanation: The darkest a crevice can get, in thousandths.
controls.label: Occlusion strength
